goal.title: Your goal
goal.intro: Your 8 weeks are built around it. You can change it later.
goal.label: Goal
goal.muscle: Build muscle with loads that keep climbing.
goal.recomposition: Lose fat, keep the muscle. Circuits and finishers.
goal.general-fitness: Strength, cardio and core, in balance.

level.title: Your level
level.intro: It sets the volume, how hard sets get and which variations you start with.
level.label: Level
level.beginner: Little or no strength training so far.
level.returning: You have trained before, just not in recent months.
level.intermediate: Training regularly for 6 months or more.
level.advanced: Years of training. You know your numbers.

schedule.title: Your schedule
schedule.noFixedDays: No fixed weekdays: do the next one whenever you can.
schedule.short: Under 30 min, every session works the whole body.

desc.4: Upper and lower body, twice each.
desc.5: One focus per session, more volume per muscle.
desc.6: The 5 sessions plus an easy cardio day.
desc.rotating: Three full-body sessions rotating across your {{days}} days.

equipment.title: Your equipment
equipment.intro: Tick what you own and set it up as it is at home. Suggested loads start from there.
equipment.none: Nothing to tick? Every session then uses bodyweight, a chair, a wall and a door.

bodyweight.title: Your bodyweight
bodyweight.intro: Used to estimate your starting loads.
bodyweight.label: Bodyweight
bodyweight.skip: Left empty, starting loads assume 70 kg. You can add it in your profile later.
bodyweight.error: Enter a weight between 30 and 250 kg, or leave it empty.

split.6: one focus per session and a cardio day

generating.title: Building your programme
generating.exercises: Exercises picked from the {{count}} your equipment allows

restore.title: Restore this backup?
restore.noProgramme: It has no programme in progress: you’ll finish the set-up afterwards.
restore.copy: What’s already on this phone is downloaded just before.
restore.doneSetup: Backup restored. Finish the set-up to create your programme.
restore.failed: The backup couldn’t be restored. Nothing was changed.
